title: Mobile Device Management
scenario: NewVue Health plans to manage company-owned endpoints by using Microsoft Intune. Before broader deployment begins, the system administrator must understand the enrollment workflow, the relationship between device registration and management, the purpose of compliance, and how device-management settings are verified in the administrative environment. Because this is a complementary activity, use the case study and reference information below to complete the required tasks.

activities.title: Task 1 - Enroll a Device
activities.prompt:
Drag and Drop Task
You want to enroll a Windows device into the cloud management environment.
To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Sign in to the device with an organizational account
Register the device with Microsoft Entra ID
answer: Sign in to the device with an organizational account
Register the device with Microsoft Entra ID
activities.explanation: Enrollment requires organizational sign-in, registration, management enrollment, and final validation.

activities.title: Task 2 - Identify Management Components
activities.prompt:
Matching Task
You want to explain the role of each cloud management component.
To answer, match each component on the left with its primary function on the right.
activities.explanation: Successful endpoint management depends on distinguishing identity registration, device management, and compliance evaluation.

activities.title: Task 3 - Explain Compliance
activities.prompt:
Dropdown Task
You want to ensure that managed endpoints meet the organization’s baseline security expectations.
To answer, select the reason compliance policies are applied.
activities.explanation: Compliance policies are used to measure whether devices satisfy required security conditions.

activities.title: Task 4 - Validate Device Visibility
activities.prompt:
Dropdown Task
You want to confirm that a device is visible in the cloud management environment after enrollment.
To answer, select the administrative location that best supports that validation.
options: Devices in the Intune admin center
Billing in the Microsoft 365 admin center
Domains in the Microsoft 365 admin center
Local Users and Groups on the workstation
activities.answer: Devices in the Intune admin center
activities.explanation: Cloud-managed device records are reviewed in the Intune device-management interface.

activities.title: Task 5 - Apply a Device Policy
activities.prompt:
Drag and Drop Task
You want to deploy a device policy after enrollment has completed.
To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Create or select a device policy
Assign the policy to the target group
answer: Create or select a device policy
Assign the policy to the target group
activities.explanation: Policy deployment begins with policy selection, continues through assignment, and ends with deployment validation.

activities.title: Task 6 - Connect Before Device Queries
activities.prompt:
PowerShell Task
You want to query cloud-managed devices by using Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
To answer, select the appropriate value for the missing portion of the command.
activities.explanation: Cloud device queries through Microsoft Graph begin with Connect-MgGraph.

activities.title: Task 7 - Relate Registration and Management
activities.prompt:
Dropdown Task
You want to distinguish device identity from device management.
To answer, select the statement that best reflects that relationship.
options: A device can be registered in Microsoft Entra ID and then managed through Intune
Intune replaces the need for device identity entirely
Device management happens before cloud registration exists
Compliance policies create the tenant domain
activities.answer: A device can be registered in Microsoft Entra ID and then managed through Intune
activities.explanation: Cloud device identity and cloud device management are related but distinct functions.
